data-the-answer-for-a-key-and-what-the-b.text: Data: the answer for a key and what the booking does.

invariants.text: a refused booking leaves no trace: no fee, no submission, no staged bundle, no journal entry that blocks the wallet.

the read happens after the check that the registry is a served one and before the booking is built, so the existing refusals for an unserved registry and an old or foreign state keep their wording and order.
the reader's answer is read at the tip the booking would be built at.
